$comment: The home group (the repository root). What every hub installs from this group. Local plugins: every folder under the include patterns (plugins/*) that holds a bb plugin, except exclude. Remote plugins: other PUBLIC repositories, installed straight from there ({ "repo": "owner/name or https URL", "path"?: "folder in that repo", "ref"?: "branch/tag/semver:..." }); private repositories are not supported. Uninstall: plugin ids every hub uninstalls (with their data); filled when a local plugin is deleted, emptied when it is added again. Marketplace plugins: from bb's marketplaces ({ "id", "marketplace"?, "source"? }). Manage them with bb hub plugin add/remove and bb hub marketplace add/remove. syncIntervalMinutes (5-1440): the shared sync interval; every hub syncs at the same UTC-aligned times. groups: the other groups in this repository, each in its own folder with the same files; machines subscribe to them with bb hub group subscribe <id>. When the same plugin id is in several subscribed groups, the newest version wins.
name: Home
